newsitem.title: CHINA: China buys two Russian submarines for $200 million.
newsitem.headline: China buys two Russian submarines for $200 million.

text.p: China has bought two Project 636 Kilo-class diesel-powered submarines from Russia for $200 million, a newspaper available in Beijing on Monday said.

Construction of the two submarines had been completed and they were currently undergoing tests in the Gulf of Finland, the Yangcheng evening news said in its July 23 edition. The cost of the purchase was $200 million, it said.
The two submarines, the first Project 636 models to be sold overseas by Russia, could be deployed in the waters around Hong Kong, it said.
The Project 636 was fitted with automatic torpedo launching equipment and advanced noise reduction devices, it said.
The Chinese navy has about 100 diesel-powered submarines, equipped with only 1950s technology, as well as two earlier models of the Russian-made Kilo and five nuclear submarines, analysts have said.
China's military has stepped up spending on defence weaponry since the 1991 Gulf War shocked Beijing with the devastating, long-range fire power of Western aircraft and cruise missiles.
